label: 魔腕の断界
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame DANGEROUS ACTION 魔腕の断界 by 魔神 EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: EXACT SIX arms: outer upper pair pulls to (290,330),(760,330), outer middle pair pulls (270,480),(780,480), inner lower pair holds (420,620),(620,620). Release outer pairs forward/down (210,540),(810,540),(240,670),(780,670), then return. Three connected shoulder roots each side, no merged or extra arm. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference. EXACTLY SIX arms in three pairs, each with its own shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and hand. Preserve frontal readable arm spread and rotate gaze/torso only slightly LEFT 15 degrees; never hide an entire arm. Original dark halo and two legs.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 外側の腕を引いて、全身を前へ倒し多腕を放つ派手な姿勢。
issues: 発動で腕が前面へ集まり6腕の肩接続が隠れる。各腕の肩・肘・手首を追い、腕の合体や入れ替わりを検収する。
発動時に腰と足の高さが大きく変わる。浮遊の基準位置・輪・角の同一体格を合わせる。
